function CRj takes nothing returns nothing
local integer JG=GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()))
local real EN=GetUnitX(GetTriggerUnit())
local real JS=GetUnitY(GetTriggerUnit())
local integer VM=GetUnitTypeId(GetTriggerUnit())
local integer hP=0
local string sV=GetUnitName(GetTriggerUnit())
local integer sW=0
if kW[JG]==kX then
set sW=0
else
set sW=2
endif
if LN[JG]<=0 then
call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(Player(JG),0,0,3,"|cff04ffc4[알림]|r |cffFF8200리롤 횟수|r를 모두 소진했습니다.")
call IssueImmediateOrder(GetTriggerUnit(),"holdposition")
return
endif
if kW[JG]!=kX and GetPlayerState(Player(JG),PLAYER_STATE_RESOURCE_LUMBER)<sW then
call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(Player(JG),0,0,3,"|cff04ffc4[알림]|r |cffFF8200목재|r가 부족합니다. (|cffFF82002 목재|r 필요)")
call IssueImmediateOrder(GetTriggerUnit(),"holdposition")
return
endif
set LN[JG]=LN[JG]-1
call SetPlayerState(Player(JG),PLAYER_STATE_RESOURCE_LUMBER,GetPlayerState(Player(JG),PLAYER_STATE_RESOURCE_LUMBER)-sW)
call BdD(GetTriggerUnit())
loop
set hP=BFi(0,41)
exitwhen kd[hP]!=VM
endloop
set bj_lastCreatedUnit=CreateUnit(Player(JG),kd[hP],EN,JS,bj_UNIT_FACING)
call UnitAddAbility(bj_lastCreatedUnit,$41305945)
call IssueImmediateOrder(bj_lastCreatedUnit,"holdposition")
call DisplayTimedTextToForce(bj_FORCE_ALL_PLAYERS,5,GetPlayerName(Player(JG))+"님이 |cffff8200희귀 리롤|r 을(를) 사용하여 \n"+sV+" → "+GetUnitName(bj_lastCreatedUnit)+" 으로 변환되었습니다!")
if LN[JG]<=0 then
call SetPlayerAbilityAvailable(Player(JG),$41305945,false)
call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(Player(JG),0,0,3,"|cff04ffc4[알림]|r |cffFF8200리롤 횟수|r를 모두 소진했습니다.")
else
call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(Player(JG),0,0,3,"|cff04ffc4[알림]|r |cffFF8200리롤 횟수|r가 |cffff0000"+I2S(LN[JG])+"|r회 남았습니다.")
endif
endfunction
